topic: E-130J original EMD scope to 2026 training-system option execution
public_statement: The Dec. 18, 2024 E-130J EMD award included training courseware/devices, integration laboratories, product support, initial spares, and test/delivery of three engineering development model aircraft.
internal_content: The March 2, 2026 P00011 modification exercises options for design, development, and delivery of E-130J training weapon-system materials/courseware and obligates FY2026 RDT&E funds. It advances the training-support portion of the contract but does not establish aircraft delivery or test/acceptance completion.
notes: Same-contract lineage. Training-system execution must not be counted as evidence that aircraft delivery, full-system PDR, CSIL, Integrated Test 1, or acceptance occurred.
